bad.title: A question about a future habit
bad.text: People guess kindly about what they’d do, which says little about what they will do.

bad.title: 5 of 5 said yes
bad.text: Five kind answers, and no hint of where people would look for Split.
bad.wait: Press Ask all five to see this.

bad.title: Few found Split after release
bad.text: Most still paid the whole bill and asked for money by message.
bad.wait: Press Ask all five, then See what happened after release, to see this.

good.title: A real task with real money
good.text: Dinner for four, paid by one person. People act it out instead of predicting.

good.title: P1 looks for Request on the receipt
good.text: A place to look that no yes or no could have shown.
good.wait: Press Watch five sessions to see this.

good.title: 2 of 5 found Split
good.text: And 2 looked on the receipt, which says where Split should go.
good.wait: Press Watch five sessions to see this.

bad.title: The task names the tab
bad.text: “Memories” is right there in the task, so people only need to spot the word.

bad.title: Straight to Memories in 3 seconds
bad.text: Fast, and it says nothing about whether people would find it alone.
bad.wait: Press Give the task to see this.

good.title: The task names the goal
good.text: Beach photos from last summer, with no tab named.

good.title: Search is where they look first
good.text: “summer” brings back three summers, mixed. The named task hid this.
good.wait: Press Give the task to see this.

good.title: Memories, found after 40 seconds
good.text: After Search and Albums. Now the team knows Memories is hard to find.
good.wait: Press Give the task and wait to see this.

bad.title: Help comes 4 seconds into the stall
bad.text: “It’s under Share.” ends it before anyone learns why it happened.
bad.wait: Press Play session to see this.

bad.title: “No problems,” say the notes
bad.text: Export hiding under Share, the one real problem, never makes it in.
bad.wait: Press Play session and wait to see this.

good.title: Quiet at 0:24
good.text: The stall runs on, and they try File and Print before Share.
good.wait: Press Play session to see this.

good.title: “What did you expect?” at the end
good.text: “Export next to Print.” The answer says where Export belongs.
good.wait: Press Play session and wait to see this.

good.title: The notes name the stall
good.text: 35 seconds stuck, and where they expected Export to be.
good.wait: Press Play session and wait to see this.

bad.title: The version keeps moving
bad.text: Each session changes the form, so by P5 no two people saw the same design.

bad.title: One change undoes another
bad.text: P4 missed the new Repeat switch, so it went back to how it was.
bad.wait: Press Log session four times to see this.

bad.title: Nothing seen twice on one design
bad.text: P1 and P5 both missed the time zone menu, but in different places.
bad.wait: Press Log session five times to see this.

good.title: Version 1 for all five
good.text: Every person meets the same form, so their problems can be compared.

good.title: One row per problem, one column per person
good.text: Each session fills in its column, so repeats line up across the row.

good.title: Time zone menu: 4 of 5
good.text: Fix it and Repeat, at 2 of 5. Guests in the title was one person.
good.wait: Press Log session five times to see this.

bad.title: A count of clicks
bad.text: 2,100 presses on Reorder, and no sign of how many reorders finished.

bad.title: Up 98% in Sale week
bad.text: Visitors doubled to 70,000, and clicks doubled with them. Reordering got no easier.
bad.wait: Press Sale week to see this.

good.title: A share, not a count
good.text: 12% of people who opened a past order finished a reorder.

good.title: Still 12% in Sale week
good.text: 1,008 of 8,400. Twice the visitors, and the number holds still.
good.wait: Press Sale week to see this.

bad.title: Listening time is the only number
bad.text: Nothing in the table can show what autoplay costs people.

bad.title: C leads with 52 minutes
bad.text: The longest listening, and nothing here to question it.

bad.title: 11% turn autoplay off
bad.text: A month after C ships, reviews say it plays songs people don’t want.
bad.wait: Press Ship next to C to see this.

good.title: A guardrail with its limit
good.text: Max 5% turning autoplay off, set before anyone saw the results.

good.title: C crosses the line at 11%
good.text: Its 52 minutes stop mattering once it’s over 5%.

good.title: B ships, under the limit
good.text: 5 more minutes a day than A, and only 4% turn it off.
good.wait: Press Ship next to B to see this.

bad.title: A goal with no number
bad.text: “Fewer parcels” has no starting value to compare against later.

bad.title: No event in the pull request
bad.text: Nothing records when people pick a suggested address.

bad.title: Only page views to look at
bad.text: Two weeks on, nobody can tell whether failed deliveries went down.
bad.wait: Press Two weeks later to see this.

good.title: A number with today’s value
good.text: Failed deliveries per 100 orders, now 4.1, written into the brief.

good.title: The event ships with the form
good.text: It records that a suggestion was picked, never the address people typed.

good.title: From 4.1 to 2.6 per 100 orders
good.text: And 38% of orders used a suggestion, so the answer is there on day 14.
good.wait: Press Two weeks later to see this.

bad.title: Down 33%, and nothing else
bad.text: The number says alerts dropped, not why they did.

bad.title: Remove the feature next quarter
bad.text: The drop is read as people not wanting alerts anymore.

good.title: Threads and sessions beside the number
good.text: 3 support threads and 5 sessions, one click from the drop.

good.title: 4 of 5 looked next to the price
good.text: The bell moved under More, and people can’t find it.
good.wait: Press Sessions (5) to see this.

good.title: Move the bell back
good.text: The same 33% drop leads to the opposite decision.
good.wait: Press Decide to see this.

bad.title: Light, at desktop width, only
bad.text: The one setup where the boarding pass was built, so it looks right.
bad.wait: Press Run checks to see this.

bad.title: “No issues” from one screenshot
bad.text: The faint gate and the cut-off button are on screens nobody checked.
bad.wait: Press Run checks to see this.

good.title: Dark: gate and time too faint
good.text: Gate B12 and 14:05 fade on the dark card.
good.wait: Press Run checks to see this.

good.title: 360px: “Add to wallet” is cut off
good.text: The button people need at the gate doesn’t fit on a phone.
good.wait: Press Run checks to see this.

good.title: 4 screenshots, 2 problems
good.text: Both caught in seconds, before anyone at the gate runs into them.
good.wait: Press Run checks to see this.

bad.title: Only Uploaded, with notes.pdf
bad.text: A short sample name, in the one state that already works.
bad.wait: Press Run checks to see this.

bad.title: A real file fails after release
bad.text: Its long name pushes Retry out of view, the one button people need.
bad.wait: Press Run checks, then Use a real file name, to see this.

good.title: Uploading, with its progress bar
good.text: 60% and a bar, a state a finished upload never shows.
good.wait: Press Run checks to see this.

good.title: The long name hides Retry
good.text: Caught before release, in the Failed state with a real file name.
good.wait: Press Run checks to see this.

good.title: Shortened, and Retry stays in view
good.text: The fix is checked in the same state that broke.
good.wait: Press Run checks, then Fix the long name, to see this.

bad.title: Three findings, none opened
bad.text: Nobody checks them against the brief before changing anything.

bad.title: Pay looks ready too early
bad.text: The “fix” makes Pay look active, though tapping it still does nothing.
bad.wait: Press Fix all to see this.

good.title: Finding 1 is dismissed
good.text: Pay stays off until the card number is filled in, so low contrast is right.
good.wait: Press Open on finding 1 to see this.

good.title: Finding 2 is confirmed
good.text: “Total €42.00” really ends at “Total €4” at 360px.
good.wait: Press Open on finding 2 to see this.

good.title: The reason is written down
good.text: 2 fixes to make, and the dismissal says why Pay looks that way.
good.wait: Open all three findings to see this.

bad.title: Create account, second in the tab order
bad.text: It sits at the bottom, but Tab jumps there straight from Name.

bad.title: The focus order gives it away
bad.text: From Name, Tab goes to Create account, then Password, and Email comes last.

bad.title: 0 issues from the scan
bad.text: The scan can’t see focus order, yet it’s why the form was marked accessible.

good.title: Create account comes last
good.text: Name, Email, Password, then the button, the same order as on screen.

good.title: The focus order matches the screen
good.text: From Name, Tab goes to Email, the field right beside it.

good.title: A person checked it too
good.text: A keyboard pass and a screen reader pass sit next to the scan’s 0 issues.
